lead: A headphones photo can still become the opening shot. AIVideosUGC builds that unboxing from the photo or the product page, box and pair both in frame.
benefits_h2: Benefits of an AI Unboxing Video
benefits_lead: You get the next headphones open without clearing a table for a camera and a free afternoon.

benefits.t: A Full Open Without a Shoot
benefits.d: You get the headphones coming out of the box, with the sentence already in it. Try it once that pair is the one you plan to announce.
A 15-second open uses 60 credits, and a failed clip returns those credits. The charge appears before each render.
Two opens can share one photo of the navy headphones. One talks about the fit, one talks about the case. Buy the audience that answers.
When a headphones open starts to feel familiar, change the first sentence, keep the pair in frame, and replace the tired cut.
A headphones line can use the name you sell under. You set the words, and the actor does not upgrade them to a fancier label.

steps_h2: How to Create an Unboxing Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: A white candle photo goes in. The file you download is that jar coming out of the box.

Download the 9:16 candle clip, or send it when the ad account is the one that will spend.

faq.q: What is an AI unboxing video?
faq.a: It shows a mailer opening onto the headphones you sell, with an actor who can name what is inside. You do not film the table.

faq.q: How do I make an unboxing with AI?
faq.a: Start with the headphones photo, and say if you want tissue in the shot. Download the open after you approve the sentence the actor will speak.

faq.q: Which AI unboxing flow should I use?
faq.a: Use this flow when the product should come out of a mailer on camera. A general spoken ad, with no parcel, starts on [UGC video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: Do I have to pay to make an unboxing?
faq.a: No free run. Every clip spends credits on a monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A 15-second open uses 60 credits, and failed clips return those credits.

faq.q: Can I run the unboxing as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The clip on a paid plan can be the ad you pay to run, and the file has no watermark. Do not present it as a buyer filming a package they received.

faq.q: Which sizes and lengths can I download?
faq.a: Choose a square, a wide 16:9, or a tall 9:16 frame, plus 4:3 and 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I open a whole catalog at once?
faq.a: Yes. Each product can get an open from its own photo. Your shop software can request those jobs through an API.

faq.q: Do AI unboxing videos perform as well as filmed ones?
faq.a: We do not promise a result. A filmed open is the one to keep when someone who received the order can show it. Use the generated open when you still need to see which first line is worth buying.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject an AI unboxing?
faq.a: Read the ad account's current rule before you fund the open. If a viewer could think a buyer filmed their own package, add the label that account asks for.
